title: Bashar Reveals The Complete History of Atlantis & Lemuria (Channeled by Darryl Anka)

opening_summary: The transcript begins with audience Q&A addressing various esoteric topics including monatomic elements, astral projections, and metaphysical concepts. The session progresses into an extensive discussion of Atlantis and Lemuria, covering their histories, technologies, destructions, and influence on modern civilizations. Bashar explains that Atlantis existed in three phases over approximately 50,000 years, with the final destruction occurring around 12,800 years ago due to cometary impact. The civilization was highly advanced, using vibrational resonance with crystals rather than nuclear weapons, and deliberately seeded knowledge through architectural structures like the Great Pyramid.
